title: VIE objects configuration
description: vie.objects-config/1 — versioned configuration for intensity-object extraction (VIE-SPEC-REP 1.1.0 §R5). additionalProperties:false everywhere so typos fail loudly (MASTER_PLAN §3.8).

connectivity.description: 4 = von Neumann neighbourhood. 8 is an explicit extension point and MUST fail validation until a later spec revision defines its merging rules (VIE-SPEC-REP 1.1.0 §R2.2).

min_area.description: objects with area < min_area are discarded and counted (dropped_regions/dropped_pixels); never silently removed (1.1.0 §R5.1)

max_regions.description: hard cap per frame; exceeding it raises RegionExtractionError instead of truncating (1.1.0 §R5.2)
